main.description: Successor's pre-acceptance of designated steward role on a specific land trust. Required for each successor named in a steward-succession-declaration. Per ADR-2605192345 §1.1.

donorDid.description: DID of the donor who named this successor.

successorRole.description: Position in the donor's succession declaration.

willAcceptStewardship.description: Must be true for the pre-acceptance to be valid.

acknowledgmentText.description: Canonical text: 'I acknowledge that if I succeed as steward of land #{landId}, I accept Lv5 護 stewardship duties (annual boundary inspection, biodiversity census, reasonable adherent access, no commercial extraction, national obligation maintenance) per ADR-2605192245 §5.1 and §1.11 of the Mission Charter.'

successorSignature.description: DID-bound signature by successor over the acknowledgmentText.
